# CloudHoste - High-Performance European Cloud & VPS Hosting

> Secure, 100% GDPR-compliant KVM NVMe Cloud Hosting, Dedicated Servers, & Self-Hosted n8n Infrastructure in Europe from €1.99/mo.

CloudHoste is a premier European cloud infrastructure and hosting provider specializing in high-speed KVM NVMe virtual private servers, managed WordPress hosting, dedicated bare-metal servers, sPanel web hosting, and pre-configured n8n workflow automation instances. Hosted in certified Tier-3 European data centers (Frankfurt, Germany | Amsterdam, Netherlands | Milan, Italy | London, UK) with redundant 10Gbps connectivity, 1.2Tbps DDoS protection, 99.9% uptime SLA, and 24/7 expert support.

---

## 🚀 Core Hosting Products & Solutions

- [Standard Web Hosting](https://cloudhoste.eu/web-hosting.html): Fast sPanel web hosting from €1.99/mo with NVMe storage, free Let's Encrypt SSL, unmetered bandwidth, automated daily backups, and 1-click app installer.
- [Managed WordPress Hosting](https://cloudhoste.eu/wp-hosting.html): High-speed WordPress hosting from €0.99/mo powered by LiteSpeed Web Server, LSCache, automatic core/plugin updates, and staging environments.
- [sPanel Web Hosting](https://cloudhoste.eu/spanel-hosting.html): Enterprise sPanel hosting from €2.49/mo with CloudLinux isolation, LiteSpeed, Softaculous, and free SSL certificates.
- [SSD NVMe VPS Hosting](https://cloudhoste.eu/vps-hosting.html): High-frequency KVM Virtual Private Servers from €2.99/mo featuring dedicated vCPU cores, NVMe SSD arrays, root access, and 30-second instant provisioning.
- [Cheap NVMe VPS Europe](https://cloudhoste.eu/buy-vps-cheap-price.html): Low-cost European VPS hosting from €2.99/mo with 10Gbps uplinks, full SSH root control, and custom OS ISO mounting.
- [n8n Workflow Automation Hosting](https://cloudhoste.eu/n8n-hosting.html): One-click self-hosted n8n instances starting at €3.99/mo with dedicated RAM, unlimited execution triggers, Docker compose, and reverse proxy setup. Save 90%+ compared to Zapier/Make.
- [Cloud Server Hosting](https://cloudhoste.eu/cloud-server-hosting.html): Scalable enterprise cloud compute instances starting at €9.99/mo with instant resource scaling and load balancing.
- [Dedicated Server Hosting](https://cloudhoste.eu/dedicated-server-hosting.html): Bare-metal dedicated servers from €49.99/mo with AMD EPYC / Intel Xeon processors, hardware RAID, unmetered bandwidth, and IPMI out-of-band access.
- [Domain Registration & Transfer](https://cloudhoste.eu/domain.html): Top-level domain registration (.eu, .com, .de, .it, .io, .net) starting from €4.99/yr with free WHOIS privacy and advanced DNS management.

## ⚙️ Technical Specifications & Architecture

- **Data Center Locations**: Certified Tier-3 facilities in Frankfurt (Germany), Amsterdam (Netherlands), Milan (Italy), and London (UK).
- **Data Sovereignty & Compliance**: 100% EU GDPR compliant with strict privacy controls, European data residence, and ISO 27001 certification.
- **Hardware Stack**: Latest-gen AMD EPYC & Intel Xeon processors, Enterprise PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSDs in RAID-10 configuration, DDR4/DDR5 ECC RAM.
- **Network & Security**: Automated 1.2Tbps scrubbing DDoS mitigation included free on all plans; redundant dual-homed 10Gbps uplinks.
- **Supported Operating Systems**: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 LTS, Debian 11/12, AlmaLinux 9, Rocky Linux 9, CentOS Stream, Windows Server 2022/2025.
